QleisliKernel.Qirf.checkContract_conditions : ∀ (artifact : QleisliKernel.Qirf.Artifact) (order : Array.{0} Nat)
  (required : QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Contract) (work left : Nat),
  Eq.{1} (ExceptT.run.{0, 0} (QleisliKernel.Qirf.checkContract artifact order required) work)
      (Prod.mk.{0, 0} (Except.ok.{0, 0} Unit.unit) left) →
    ∃ root actual wrapper a b c,
      And
        (Eq.{1} (ExceptT.run.{0, 0} (QleisliKernel.Qirf.Validity.checkRoot artifact order) work)
          (Prod.mk.{0, 0} (Except.ok.{0, 0} root) a))
        (And
          (Eq.{1} (QleisliKernel.Qirf.Artifact.rootInterface artifact)
            (some.{0}
              (Prod.mk.{0, 0}
                (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Encoding.physical
                  (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Contract.input required))
                (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Encoding.physical
                  (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Contract.input required)))))
          (And
            (Eq.{1}
              (QleisliKernel.Raw.BranchFunction.preflight
                (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Encoding.physical
                  (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Contract.input required))
                (QleisliKernel.Qirf.Validity.Root.program root))
              true)
            (And
              (Eq.{1}
                (ExceptT.run.{0, 0}
                  (QleisliKernel.Raw.BranchFunction.reconstruct (QleisliKernel.Qirf.Validity.Root.dependencies root)
                    (QleisliKernel.Qirf.Validity.Root.program root))
                  a)
                (Prod.mk.{0, 0} (Except.ok.{0, 0} actual) b))
              (And
                (Eq.{1} (ExceptT.run.{0, 0} (QleisliKernel.Finite.wholeSpace actual) b)
                  (Prod.mk.{0, 0} (Except.ok.{0, 0} Unit.unit) c))
                (Eq.{1}
                  (ExceptT.run.{0, 0}
                    (QleisliKernel.Finite.check
                      (List.cons.{0}
                        {
                          signature :=
                            QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Encoding.physical
                              (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Contract.input required),
                          meaning := actual }
                        List.nil.{0})
                      (QleisliKernel.Qirf.contractCircuit
                        (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Encoding.physical
                          (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Contract.input required)))
                      required required)
                    c)
                  (Prod.mk.{0, 0} (Except.ok.{0, 0} wrapper) left))))))
Qleisli.NativeContract.Wrapper.circuitMatrix_entries : ∀ (signature : QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Basis)
  (meaning actual : QleisliKernel.Semantics.Exact.Matrix) (work left : Nat),

      (ExceptT.run.{0, 0}
        (QleisliKernel.Finite.circuitMatrix (List.cons.{0} { signature := signature, meaning := meaning } List.nil.{0})
          (QleisliKernel.Qirf.contractCircuit signature))
        work)
      (Prod.mk.{0, 0} (Except.ok.{0, 0} actual) left) →
    And (Eq.{1} (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Exact.Matrix.rows actual) (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Exact.Matrix.rows meaning))
      (And
        (Eq.{1} (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Exact.Matrix.cols actual) (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Exact.Matrix.cols meaning))
        (∀ (row col : Nat),
          LT.lt.{0} row (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Exact.Matrix.rows meaning) →
            LT.lt.{0} col (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Exact.Matrix.cols meaning) →
              Eq.{1} (Qleisli.Semantics.Exact.entry actual row col) (Qleisli.Semantics.Exact.entry meaning row col)))

@Qleisli.NativeContract.Wrapper.check_reference_original : ∀ {R : Type}
  (signature : QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Basis) (meaning actual : QleisliKernel.Semantics.Exact.Matrix)
  (required : QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Contract) (work left : Nat),

          (QleisliKernel.Qirf.contractCircuit signature) required required)
        work)
      (Prod.mk.{0, 0} (Except.ok.{0, 0} actual) left) →
    ∀ (joint : Nat → R → Complex) (row : Nat) (reference : R),
      LT.lt.{0} row (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Exact.Matrix.rows meaning) →
        Eq.{1}
          (Qleisli.Semantics.Exact.action meaning
            (fun index r =>
              Qleisli.Semantics.Exact.action
                (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Encoding.map (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Contract.input required))
                joint index r)
            row reference)
          (Qleisli.Semantics.Exact.action
            (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Encoding.map (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Contract.output required))
            (fun index r =>
              Qleisli.Semantics.Exact.action (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Contract.logical required) joint index r)
            row reference)

        (Prod.mk.{0, 0} (Except.ok.{0, 0} root) a))

        (Eq.{1}
          (ExceptT.run.{0, 0}
            (QleisliKernel.Raw.BranchFunction.reconstruct (QleisliKernel.Qirf.Validity.Root.dependencies root)
              (QleisliKernel.Qirf.Validity.Root.program root))
            a)

        (And
          (Eq.{1} (ExceptT.run.{0, 0} (QleisliKernel.Finite.wholeSpace actual) b)
            (Prod.mk.{0, 0} (Except.ok.{0, 0} Unit.unit) c))
          (And
            (Eq.{1}
              (ExceptT.run.{0, 0}

                  (List.cons.{0}
                    {
                      signature :=
                        QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Encoding.physical
                          (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Contract.input
                            (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.EncodedAcceptance.required binding)),

Qleisli.NativeContract.check_encoded_sound : ∀ (bytes : ByteArray) (answer : Bool) (work left : Nat),
  Eq.{1} (ExceptT.run.{0, 0} (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.check bytes) work)
      (Prod.mk.{0, 0} (Except.ok.{0, 0} answer) left) →
    ∃ binding,
      match QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.Acceptance.request binding with
      | QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.RequestAcceptance.encoded request =>
        ∃ root actual,
          Qleisli.NativeContract.EncodedMeaning (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.Acceptance.artifact binding)
            (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.Acceptance.order binding) root
            (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.EncodedAcceptance.required request) actual
      | QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.RequestAcceptance.leaf request =>
        And
          (Eq.{1} (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.LeafAcceptance.actual request)
            (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.LeafAcceptance.matrix request))
          (Qleisli.NativeContract.LeafMeaning (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.Acceptance.artifact binding)
            (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.Acceptance.order binding)
            (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.LeafAcceptance.root request)
            (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.LeafAcceptance.signature request)
            (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.LeafAcceptance.input request)
            (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.LeafAcceptance.output request)
            (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.LeafAcceptance.matrix request))
@Qleisli.NativeContract.encoded_reference : ∀ {R : Type} {artifact : QleisliKernel.Qirf.Artifact}
  {order : Array.{0} Nat} {value : Lean.Json} {work left : Nat}
  (binding : QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.EncodedAcceptance artifact order value work left),
  ∃ root actual,
    And
      (Qleisli.NativeContract.EncodedMeaning artifact order root
        (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.EncodedAcceptance.required binding) actual)
      (∀ (joint : Nat → R → Complex) (row : Nat) (reference : R),
        LT.lt.{0} row (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Exact.Matrix.rows actual) →
          Eq.{1}
            (Qleisli.Semantics.Exact.action actual
              (fun index r =>
                Qleisli.Semantics.Exact.action
                  (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Encoding.map
                    (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Contract.input
                      (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.EncodedAcceptance.required binding)))
                  joint index r)
              row reference)
            (Qleisli.Semantics.Exact.action
              (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Encoding.map
                (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Contract.output
                  (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.EncodedAcceptance.required binding)))
              (fun index r =>
                Qleisli.Semantics.Exact.action
                  (QleisliKernel.Semantics.Finite.Contract.logical
                    (QleisliKernel.Protocol.NativeContract.EncodedAcceptance.required binding))
                  joint index r)
              row reference))
